raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents three donut charts, each representing data for "Enterprises, employment and net turnover by industry, construction, trade and services in 2021" expressed as percentages of the total economy, absolute values, by NACE Rev. 2. The first donut chart represents the number of enterprises, the second represents the number of persons employed, and the third represents turnover. Each donut chart is divided into four sectors: Industry (orange), Construction (blue), Trade (green), and Other Services (light blue). The number of enterprises chart shows the following approximate percentages: Industry at 61%, Construction at 19%, Trade at 12%, and Other Services at 8%. The number of persons employed chart shows: Industry at 51%, Construction at 9%, Trade at 21%, and Other Services at 19%. The turnover chart shows: Industry at 33%, Construction at 6%, Trade at 31%, and Other Services at 6%. Each sector is labeled with its name and percentage, and also includes an absolute value in millions (mln) or billions (tln). The sectors in each donut chart appear to be arranged in descending order of size. A legend is present at the bottom of the figure, identifying the colors corresponding to each sector.
